source_arabic_selected: ويجب الأمر بالواجب والنهي عن الحرام
close_english: Commanding what is obligatory and forbidding what is prohibited are obligatory.

source_arabic_selected: بشرط العلم
close_english: Subject to the condition of knowledge.

source_arabic_selected: وبشرط تجويز التأثير
close_english: And the condition that an effect is reasonably possible.

source_arabic_selected: وبشرط انتفاء المفسدة
close_english: And the condition that an overriding harmful consequence be absent.

source_arabic_selected: منه مندوب أو واجب عيني أو غيره
close_english: It may be recommended or individually obligatory, or another kind of prescribed good.

source_arabic_selected: ولا يختص الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر بالوالي
close_english: Commanding right and forbidding wrong are not confined to a ruler or official.

source_arabic_selected: لبلوغ العوام
close_english: Concerning the involvement of ordinary people.

source_arabic_selected: ولا كراه في الدين منسوخ بآية القتال
close_english: The expression 'No compulsion in religion' is [said here to be] abrogated by the verse concerning fighting.

source_arabic_selected: فصل في حقيقة الإيمان
close_english: Chapter concerning the reality of faith.

source_arabic_selected: الإيمان هو في عرف أهل اللغة التصديق
close_english: Faith, in the usage of the people of the language, is assent or affirmation.

source_arabic_selected: أي فيما اشتهر كونه من الدين بحيث يعلمه العامة من غير افتقار إلى نظر واستدلال
close_english: That is, concerning what is widely known to belong to religion, such that ordinary believers recognize it without requiring further theoretical investigation or demonstration.

source_arabic_selected: وفي الشرع تصديق النبي فيما علم مجيئه به بالضرورة
close_english: In religious terminology, it is affirming the Prophet concerning what is necessarily known to have been brought by him.

source_arabic_selected: كوحدة الصانع ووجوب الصلاة وحرمة الخمر ونحو ذلك
close_english: Such as the unity of the Creator, the obligation of prayer, the prohibition of wine and the like.

source_arabic_selected: ويكفي التصديق بالجميع إجمالا وإنما يحتاج إلى التصديق تفصيلا عند ملاحظة التفاصيل
close_english: Assent to the whole suffices in general; detailed assent is required when the particulars themselves come under consideration.

source_arabic_selected: والأكثرون على أنه لا بد من الإقرار باللسان
close_english: The majority hold that verbal profession is also necessary.

source_arabic_selected: وهو المحكي عن أبي حنيفة رضي الله عنه
close_english: This is reported from Abū Ḥanīfa, may God be pleased with him.

source_arabic_selected: فإن الإقرار حينئذ شرط لإجراء الأحكام عليه في الدنيا
close_english: In that case, verbal profession is a condition for applying the relevant legal rulings to that person in this world.

source_arabic_selected: وكثير من السلف على أنه التصديق بالجنان والإقرار باللسان والعمل بالأركان
close_english: Many of the early authorities held that faith consists of inward assent, profession with the tongue, and action through the bodily members.

source_arabic_selected: ومع هذا لا يخرج بترك العمل من الإيمان
close_english: Even so, omitting deeds does not expel a person from faith.

source_arabic_selected: خلافا للمعتزلة
close_english: In contrast to the Muʿtazilites.

source_arabic_selected: فإنه عندهم يخرج تارك العمل عن الإيمان
close_english: According to them, the person who omits the relevant works is no longer included within faith.

source_arabic_selected: ولا يدخل في الكفر
close_english: But does not enter into unbelief.

source_arabic_selected: خلافا للخوارج
close_english: In contrast to the Khārijites.

source_arabic_selected: تارك العمل خارج عن الإيمان داخل في الكفر
close_english: The one who abandons works is outside faith and inside unbelief.

source_arabic_selected: فإن قيل كيف لا ينتفي الكل بانتفاء الجزء
close_english: If it is asked: How can the whole not cease when a part of it is absent?

source_arabic_selected: قلنا المراد أنه يطلق على ما هو الأصل وأساس دخول الجنة والنجاة
close_english: We answer that the expression is applied to what constitutes the foundation and basis of entry into Paradise and deliverance.

source_arabic_selected: وهو التصديق وحده
close_english: This is assent alone.

source_arabic_selected: وعلى ما هو الكامل المنجي
close_english: And it is also applied to the complete, saving state.

source_arabic_selected: وهو التصديق مع الإقرار والعمل
close_english: It is assent together with profession and action.

source_arabic_selected: ثم أن لنا مقامات الأول أن الإيمان فعل القلب دون مجرد اللسان
close_english: There are distinct inquiries: first, faith is an act of the heart rather than merely of the tongue.

source_arabic_selected: الثاني أنه التصديق دون المعرفة
close_english: Second, it is assent rather than knowledge.

source_arabic_selected: الثالث أن الأعمال ليست داخلة فيه بحيث ينتفي هو بانتفائها
close_english: Third, deeds are not constituents of it in such a way that faith disappears whenever they are absent.

source_arabic_selected: كتب في قلوبهم الإيمان
close_english: He has inscribed faith in their hearts.

source_arabic_selected: قالوا آمنا بأفواههم ولم تؤمن قلوبهم
close_english: They said, 'We believe,' with their mouths, while their hearts did not believe.

source_arabic_selected: ولما يدخل الإيمان في قلوبهم
close_english: Faith has not yet entered their hearts.

source_arabic_selected: اللهم ثبت قلبي على دينك
close_english: O God, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.

source_arabic_selected: في قلبه مثقال حبة من خردل من الإيمان
close_english: In his heart is the weight of a mustard seed of faith.

source_arabic_selected: إنما كان في حكم الدنيا من عصمة الدم والمال
close_english: This was with respect to worldly rulings, including protection of blood and property.

source_arabic_selected: وحقيقة الإيمان التصديق والإذعان والقبول
close_english: The reality of faith is assent, acquiescence and acceptance.

source_arabic_selected: ومقابله الإنكار والتكذيب
close_english: Its contrary is denial and rejection of the truth.

source_arabic_selected: وفي الشرع تصديق النبي فيما علم مجيئه به بالضرورة أي فيما اشتهر كونه من الدين بحيث يعلمه العامة من غير افتقار إلى نظر واستدلال كوحدة الصانع ووجوب الصلاة وحرمة الخمر ونحو ذلك ويكفي التصديق بالجميع إجمالا وإنما يحتاج إلى التصديق تفصيلا عند ملاحظة التفاصيل
close_english: In religious usage, faith is affirming the Prophet concerning what is necessarily known to have been brought by him. That is, matters so widely recognized as belonging to the religion that ordinary people know them without the need for investigation or inference—such as the unity of the Creator, the obligation of prayer, and the prohibition of wine. General assent to the whole suffices; detailed assent is required when the particulars themselves come under consideration.

source_arabic_selected: فإن قيل كيف لا ينتفي الكل بانتفاء الجزء ... قلنا المراد أنه ... يطلق على ما هو الأصل وأساس دخول الجنة والنجاة من النار وهو التصديق وحده أو مع الإقرار وعلى ما هو الكامل المنجي ... وهو التصديق مع الإقرار والعمل والأول لا ينتفي بانتفاء العمل
close_english: If it is asked: How can the whole fail to disappear when one of its parts disappears? ... We reply: the term 'faith' applies to what is the original foundation and basis for entry into Paradise and deliverance from the Fire—assent alone, or together with verbal profession—and also to the complete saving state, ... which is assent together with verbal profession and deeds. The first sense does not disappear merely through the omission of works.

close_english: Know that what is recognized as good comprises both the obligatory and the recommended, while what is reprehensible comprises the forbidden and the disliked.

close_english: I say: it has been established among the disputants that there are four approaches here. First, faith is a name for assent or knowledge alone.

close_english: According to them, the person under discussion is a believer as between himself and God, but the application of the outward legal rulings to him does not necessarily follow.
